note_gaps: Exact forward-dynamics microsecond values live only in the unparsed Fig. 3 plot, not recoverable from text; the closed-form penetration-depth expression (Sec. V, following Eq. 28) was not preserved by PDF-to-text conversion, only the mass-independence claim survives.
contact_model: soft, convex, complementarity-free; a unified impulse vector covers joint dry friction, joint/tendon/distance limits, and frictional contacts together, with an elliptical friction cone whose dimensionality per contact is 2 (sliding), 3, or 5 (sliding+torsional+rolling)
solver: GPGS (generalized projected Gauss-Seidel, described as the authors' own unpublished-at-the-time method handling cone and pyramid constraints) for the contact/limit impulse; a separate 'soft Gauss principle' derivation for equality/holonomic constraints; an analytically-invertible closed-form solver for a restricted circular-cone special case
throughput: single-core Intel i7-3930K (Windows 7): forward dynamics of a 27-dof humanoid with 10 contacts evaluated in 0.1 ms (100x real-time at a 10 ms timestep); inverse dynamics of the same humanoid under 100 impulses in 30 microseconds (10 microseconds with no impulses); no parallel/multi-environment throughput reported
